SF2ECC.WrongSystem: Starfinder 2e Character Creator requires the Starfinder 2e (sf2e) system.
SF2ECC.NotACharacter: The character creator only works on player characters.
SF2ECC.ApplyFailed: The character creator could not finish: {message}

AllowRare.Name: Show uncommon and rare feats
AllowRare.Hint: Include feats with the uncommon, rare, or unique rarity in the feat pickers. Check with your GM first.

SF2ECC.DetailPlaceholder: Select an option to read about it here.
SF2ECC.NoHeritages: This ancestry has no heritages in the compendium. You can continue.

StepHelp.ancestry: Who are you? Your ancestry sets your hit points, size, speed, and the first of your attribute boosts.
StepHelp.heritage: Heritages are the traits that set you apart within your ancestry.
StepHelp.background: What did you do before adventuring? Your background gives attribute boosts, trained skills, and a skill feat.
StepHelp.class: What do you do best? Your class defines your role, proficiencies, and abilities.
StepHelp.attributes: Assign your attribute boosts. Each choice below follows the official character creation rules.
StepHelp.skills: Choose the skills you are trained in.
StepHelp.feats: Pick the feats that open up at this level.
StepHelp.review: Make sure everything looks right, then finish.

SF2ECC.AttributesHelp: Your ancestry, background, and class each grant boosts. Boosts from one source must go to different attributes. Then spend four free boosts on four different attributes. You cannot start above +4.

Error.ancestryDuplicate: Ancestry boosts must go to different attributes.
Error.backgroundDuplicate: Background boosts must go to different attributes.
Error.freeDuplicate: Free boosts must go to four different attributes.
Error.overCap: No attribute can start higher than +4. Move a boost elsewhere.

SF2ECC.LevelBoostsHelp: Level {level} grants four attribute boosts, each to a different attribute. A boost to an attribute that is already +4 or higher only counts for half a step.
SF2ECC.SkillsHelp: Choose {n} additional trained skills ({remaining} left). Skills already trained by your class or background are marked.
SF2ECC.SkillIncreaseHelp: Level {level} grants a skill increase. Raise one skill by one proficiency rank.
SF2ECC.HpGain: {hp} hit points ({classHp} from your class + {con} Constitution)
SF2ECC.NoNewFeatures: No new class features at this level.
SF2ECC.AutoGranted: Class features are added to your sheet automatically. If one asks you to make a choice, a prompt will appear when you finish.
SF2ECC.NoChoices: Nothing to choose at this level.
SF2ECC.ReviewCreateNote: Finishing adds your choices to the character sheet. Some class features and feats may ask you to make further choices.
SF2ECC.ReviewLevelNote: Finishing raises your level and adds the choices above to your sheet.
